name: Journalists’ Family Benefit Fund
benefit:
- **Financial Assistance:**

- ₹50,000/- for 5 years of service.
- ₹1,00,000/- for 10 years of service. 
- ₹1,50,000/- for 15 years of service.
- ₹2,00,000/- for 20 years of service.
_eligibility_text:
1. The deceased should have been an editor/sub-editor/reporter/photographer and proofreader.
1. The benefit of the scheme will be given only on the death of the journalist while working in Journalism.
1. The editor, sub-editor, journalist, and photographer should have worked full-time in a newspaper or daily periodicals published in Tamil Nadu.
1. In case of sudden death due to an accident or fatal disease, five years of service is mandatory.
